summary:
Implemented TimeElapsedColumn, the finished_time capture model, and Palette.__rich__ in the rich repo; nothing was run (per instructions), and nothing was committed.

Changes:
- rich/progress.py: added TimeElapsedColumn (between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn). Added Task.finished_time (defaulted field before `visible`); Task.finished is now `finished_time is not None`; Task._reset clears finished_time. Progress.update and Progress.advance capture elapsed as the last step inside the lock when completed >= total and no finished time is present (advance captures after its own pre-lock time read). Progress.reset clears finished_time before refresh. No imports or new public methods added.
- rich/default_styles.py: "progress.elapsed": Style(color="yellow").
- rich/palette.py: Palette.__rich__ with runtime imports inside the method and Table under TYPE_CHECKING only.
- tests/test_palette.py: test_rich_cast (new file).
- tests/test_progress.py: import TimeElapsedColumn; new test_time_elapsed_column driven by update/reset with a non-auto MockClock (unstarted, running, frozen, reset-then-live); test_columns gets TimeElapsedColumn after TimeRemainingColumn and its expected string regenerated.
- CHANGELOG.md: "Unreleased" section with Added entries for Progress.TimeElapsedColumn and Palette.__rich__.

test_columns expected output (hand-derived, not run): I traced every clock read. Each refresh row reads 10 clock values now (8 before, plus TimeElapsed base read and one elapsed read while unfinished). Captures: task foo at its advance read 60 (elapsed 60), task bar at read 56 (elapsed 45). Frame 1 elapsed shows 0:00:37 and 0:00:36; finished frames show 0:01:00 and 0:00:45. Speed samples shift, so both speeds become 1 byte/s (was 1 and 2). Bar widths were verified against the old output (33 and 23 cells) and are now 25 (start frames) and 16 (finished frames). The finished-frame speed column drops from 9 to 8 wide, so the trailing pad after "1 byte/s" disappears. That is a consequence of the speed value change, not a hand edit, but it goes beyond the three listed categories, so please check it when you run the test.

Not verified: no tests were run, so the new and changed tests are unconfirmed. Docs (progress.rst) were not updated, since the spec did not ask for it.
